name: SeerBit Payment Gateway plugin for WooCommerce
author: SeerBit

sections.description:
Unlock seamless payments with the SeerBit WooCommerce plugin. Easily generate invoices, access instant payouts, and accept payments through your website or secure payment links. Stay in control with a real-time mobile dashboard and manage transactions anytime, anywhere. Designed for growth, built for unified commerce.

Plugin Features

With SeerBit for WooCommerce, you can accept payments via:

*Credit/Debit Cards — Visa, Mastercard, Verve (NG, GH, KE, UGX, XOF, ZAR, TZS)
*Bank transfer (Nigeria)
*Bank accounts (Kuda Bank, Opay, etc.) Nigeria
*Mobile money (Ghana, Kenya)
*EFT (South Africa)
*USSD (Nigeria)
*Many more coming soon

Why SeerBit?

SeerBit is more than just a payment gateway—it’s a growth partner for your business. Here’s why merchants choose SeerBit:

  • Faster Payments – Enjoy instant collections, payouts, and seamless invoicing.
  • Flexible Payment Options – Accept cards, mobile money, bank transfers, bank account, and payment links.
  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration – Set up quickly and start accepting payments effortlessly.
  • Real-Time Insights – Track transactions and business performance with an intuitive dashboard.
  • Secure & Reliable – PCI-DSS compliant, ensuring safe and hassle-free transactions.
  • Built for Businesses of All Sizes – Whether you’re a startup or an enterprise, SeerBit scales with you.

Experience payments designed for speed, security, and growth choose SeerBit today.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  • Login to your WordPress Admin area
  • Go to “Plugins > Add New” from the left hand menu
  • In the search box type Woo SeerBit
  • From the search result you will see SeerBit WooCommerce Payment Gateway click on Install Now to install the plugin
  • A popup window will ask you to confirm your wish to install the Plugin.
  • After installation, activate the plugin.
  • Open the settings page for WooCommerce and click the “Checkout” tab.
  • Click on the SeerBit link from the available Checkout Options
  • Configure your __SeerBit Pay settings. See below for details.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Login to your WordPress Admin. Click on “Plugins > Add New” from the left hand menu.
  3. Click on the “Upload” option, then click “Choose File” to select the zip file from your computer. Once selected, press “OK” and press the “Install Now” button.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open the settings page for WooCommerce and click the “Checkout” tab.
  6. Click on the SeerBit link from the available Checkout Options
  7. Configure your SeerBit Pay settings. See below for details.

Configure the plugin

To configure the plugin, go to WooCommerce > Settings from the left hand menu, then click Checkout from the top tab. You will see SeerBit as part of the available Checkout Options. Click on it to configure the payment gateway.

  • Enable/Disable – check the box to enable SeerBit Pay.
  • Title – allows you to determine what your customers will see this payment option as on the checkout page.
  • Description – controls the message that appears under the payment fields on the checkout page.
  • Public Key – Enter your Public Key here. Get your API keys from your SeerBit account under Settings
  • Secret Key – Enter your Secret Key here. Get your API keys from your SeerBit account under Settings
  • Click on Save Changes for the changes you made to be effected.
sections.faq:
What Do I Need To Use The Plugin

  1. You need to have WooCommerce plugin installed and activated on your WordPress site.
  2. You need to open a SeerBit merchant account on SeerBit
